value.text: Precision correction (appended, not edited: the history stream is append-only and hash-chained). The audit line 'no --all hits' refers specifically to the host flag 'pm list --all' removed by pm-cli 2026.7.29 GH-793. It does not refer to '--all-release-tags', which is a pm-changelog flag used in .github/workflows/release.yml lines 105-107 and is unaffected by GH-793; that workflow needs no change. Re-verified after review: grep for 'list --all' across ts, md, json and yml sources returns no output.
